mapper.insert: INSERT INTO banned_posts( post_id, section_id, ban_reason) values (#{postId}, #{sectionId}, #{banReason})
mapper.select: SELECT bp.id, p.id AS postId, p.title, s.name AS sectionName, bp.ban_reason AS banReason, bp.created_at AS createdAt FROM banned_posts bp INNER JOIN posts p ON bp.post_id = p.id INNER JOIN sections s ON bp.section_id = s.id WHERE bp.section_id = #{sectionId} ORDER BY bp.created_at DESC
